steps.label: bucket-pg-query
steps.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '2026-10-31 00:59:59.9Z'::timestamptz - '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz)::bigint / 3600 AS near_hour, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '2026-10-31 01:00:00Z'::timestamptz - '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz)::bigint / 3600 AS on_hour

steps.label: bucket-pg-boundaries
steps.sql: SELECT t, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t - '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz)::bigint / 3600 AS documented_hour, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM t - '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz) / 3600)::bigint AS floored_hour FROM (SELECT '1969-12-31 23:59:59Z'::timestamptz AS t UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10-31 00:00:00Z'::timestamptz UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10-31 00:59:59.4Z'::timestamptz UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10-31 00:59:59.9Z'::timestamptz UNION ALL SELECT '2026-10-31 01:00:00Z'::timestamptz) q ORDER BY t

steps.label: distribution-query-example
steps.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN latency_dist IS NOT NULL THEN SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(latency_dist,99.0) ELSE NULL END AS p99 FROM (SELECT SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(CASE WHEN T.LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING::jsonb ->> 'COUNT' != '0' THEN T.LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING ELSE NULL END) AS latency_dist FROM SPANNER_SYS.QUERY_STATS_TOP_MINUTE AS T WHERE T.INTERVAL_END > spanner.timestamptz_subtract(now(),'1 HOUR') AND T.INTERVAL_END <= now()) AS agg

steps.label: distribution-txn-example
steps.sql: WITH aggregated_stats AS (SELECT T.FPRINT,SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_AGG(CASE WHEN T.COMMIT_LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING::jsonb ->> 'COUNT' != '0' THEN T.COMMIT_LATENCY_DISTRIBUTION_JSON_STRING ELSE NULL END) AS commit_latency_dist_str FROM SPANNER_SYS.TXN_STATS_TOP_MINUTE AS T WHERE T.INTERVAL_END > spanner.timestamptz_subtract(now(),'1 HOUR') AND T.INTERVAL_END <= now() GROUP BY T.FPRINT) SELECT FPRINT,CASE WHEN commit_latency_dist_str IS NOT NULL THEN SPANNER_SYS.DISTRIBUTION_PERCENTILE(commit_latency_dist_str,99.0) ELSE NULL END AS p99 FROM aggregated_stats
